entries.name: Acid
entries.description: Thrown in place of an attack at a creature or object within 20 feet: it must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw (DC 8 + your Dexterity modifier and Proficiency Bonus) or take 2d6 Acid damage.

entries.name: Airship
entries.description: Speed 8 mph, crew 10, 20 passengers, cargo 1 ton, AC 13, 300 HP.

entries.name: Alchemist's Fire
entries.description: Thrown in place of an attack at a creature or object within 20 feet: it must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw (DC 8 + your Dexterity modifier and Proficiency Bonus) or take 1d4 Fire damage and start burning.

entries.name: Amulet
entries.description: A holy symbol worn as an amulet, through which a cleric or a paladin channels divine magic.

entries.name: Antitoxin
entries.description: Drunk as a Bonus Action: Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the Poisoned condition for 1 hour.

entries.name: Assassin's Blood
entries.description: Ingested. DC 10 Constitution saving throw: on a failure, 6 (1d12) Poison damage and Poisoned for 24 hours; on a success, half the damage only.

entries.name: Backpack
entries.description: Holds up to 30 pounds of gear. It can also serve as a saddlebag.

entries.name: Ball Bearings
entries.description: Spilled as a Utilize action, they cover a 10-foot square: a creature entering it must succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw or fall Prone.

entries.name: Barrel
entries.description: Holds up to 40 gallons of liquid or 4 cubic feet of dry goods.

entries.name: Basket
entries.description: Holds up to 40 pounds within 2 cubic feet.

entries.name: Bedroll
entries.description: Sleeps one Small or Medium creature, which then succeeds on saving throws against extreme cold.

entries.name: Bell
entries.description: When rung, it can be heard up to 60 feet away.

entries.name: Blanket
entries.description: Wrapped in it, you have Advantage on saving throws against extreme cold.

entries.name: Block and Tackle
entries.description: Lets you hoist up to four times the weight you can normally lift.

entries.name: Book
entries.description: A book holds fiction or nonfiction. Consulting an accurate nonfiction book about its topic gives a +5 bonus to Intelligence (Arcana, History, Nature or Religion) checks you make about that topic.

entries.name: Glass Bottle
entries.description: Holds up to 1½ pints.

entries.name: Bucket
entries.description: Holds up to half a cubic foot of contents.

entries.name: Burglar's Pack
entries.description: Contains a backpack, ball bearings, a bell, 10 candles, a crowbar, a hooded lantern, 7 flasks of oil, 5 days of rations, a rope, a tinderbox and a waterskin.

entries.name: Burnt Othur Fumes
entries.description: Inhaled. DC 13 Constitution saving throw or 10 (3d6) Poison damage, then the save again at the start of each turn: 3 (1d6) Poison damage per failure. Ends after three successes.

entries.name: Caltrops
entries.description: Spread as a Utilize action over a 5-foot square: a creature entering it must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 1 Piercing damage.

entries.name: Camel
entries.description: Carries up to 450 lb.

entries.name: Candle
entries.description: Burns for 1 hour, shedding Bright Light in a 5-foot radius and Dim Light for 5 feet more.

entries.name: Carriage
entries.description: Pulled by animals, which move up to five times their carrying capacity, the vehicle included.

entries.name: Cart
entries.description: Pulled by animals, which move up to five times their carrying capacity, the vehicle included.

entries.name: Crossbow Bolt Case
entries.description: Holds up to 20 Bolts.

entries.name: Map or Scroll Case
entries.description: Holds up to 10 sheets of paper or 5 sheets of parchment.

entries.name: Chain
entries.description: As a Utilize action, binds a Grappled, Incapacitated or Restrained creature within 5 feet on a DC 13 Strength (Athletics) check: its legs bound, it is Restrained. Escaping takes a DC 18 Dexterity (Acrobatics) check, bursting it a DC 20 Strength (Athletics) check.

entries.name: Chariot
entries.description: Pulled by animals, which move up to five times their carrying capacity, the vehicle included.

entries.name: Chest
entries.description: Holds up to 12 cubic feet of contents.

entries.name: Climber's Kit
entries.description: Boot tips, gloves, pitons and a harness. Anchored as a Utilize action, you can't fall more than 25 feet from the anchor point, nor move more than 25 feet from it until you undo it as a Bonus Action.

entries.name: Fine Clothes
entries.description: Made of expensive fabrics, expertly adorned. Some events and places admit only people wearing such clothes.

entries.name: Traveler's Clothes
entries.description: Resilient garments designed for travel in various environments.

entries.name: Component Pouch
entries.description: Watertight, its compartments hold all the free Material components of your spells.

entries.name: Costume
entries.description: Gives Advantage on ability checks to impersonate the person or type of person it represents.

entries.name: Crawler Mucus
entries.description: Contact. DC 13 Constitution saving throw or Poisoned and Paralyzed for 1 minute; the save again at the end of each turn ends it on a success.

entries.name: Crowbar
entries.description: Using a crowbar gives Advantage on Strength checks where its leverage can be applied.

entries.name: Diplomat's Pack
entries.description: Contains a chest, fine clothes, ink, 5 ink pens, a lamp, 2 map or scroll cases, 4 flasks of oil, 5 sheets of paper, 5 sheets of parchment, perfume and a tinderbox.

entries.name: Disguise Kit
entries.description: Cosmetics, hair dye and small props to change your appearance.

entries.name: Dungeoneer's Pack
entries.description: Contains a backpack, caltrops, a crowbar, 2 flasks of oil, 10 days of rations, a rope, a tinderbox, 10 torches and a waterskin.

entries.name: Elephant
entries.description: Carries up to 1,320 lb.

entries.name: Emblem
entries.description: A holy symbol borne as an emblem on a shield or on clothing.

entries.name: Entertainer's Pack
entries.description: Contains a backpack, a bedroll, 2 costumes, 5 candles, 5 days of rations, a waterskin and a disguise kit.

entries.name: Essence of Ether
entries.description: Inhaled. DC 15 Constitution saving throw or Poisoned and Unconscious for 8 hours; it wakes up if it takes damage or is shaken awake.

entries.name: Explorer's Pack
entries.description: Contains a backpack, a bedroll, 2 flasks of oil, 10 days of rations, a rope, a tinderbox, 10 torches and a waterskin.

entries.name: Feed (1 day)
entries.description: Food for one mount for a day.

entries.name: Flask
entries.description: Holds up to 1 pint.

entries.name: Forgery Kit
entries.description: Dexterity. Mimic 10 words or fewer of someone else's handwriting (DC 15), or duplicate a wax seal (DC 20).

entries.name: Galley
entries.description: Speed 4 mph, crew 80, cargo 150 tons, AC 15, 500 HP, damage threshold 20.

entries.name: Grappling Hook
entries.description: Thrown as a Utilize action at a railing, ledge or other catch within 50 feet: it catches on a DC 13 Dexterity (Acrobatics) check. With a rope tied to it, you can then climb.

entries.name: Healer's Kit
entries.description: A healer's kit has ten uses. As a Utilize action, you can expend one of its uses to stabilize an Unconscious creature that has 0 Hit Points, without a Wisdom (Medicine) check.

entries.name: Holy Water
entries.description: A flask thrown at a creature within 20 feet: a Fiend or an Undead that fails its Dexterity saving throw takes 2d8 Radiant damage.

entries.name: Draft Horse
entries.description: Carries up to 540 lb.

entries.name: Riding Horse
entries.description: Carries up to 480 lb.

entries.name: Hunting Trap
entries.description: Set as a Utilize action and chained to a fixed object. A creature stepping on it must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or take 1d4 Piercing damage, its Speed 0 until its next turn, then held by the chain until it frees itself (DC 13 Strength (Athletics), 1 Piercing damage per failure).

entries.name: Ink
entries.description: A 1-ounce bottle, enough to write about 500 pages.

entries.name: Ink Pen
entries.description: Used with ink to write or draw.

entries.name: Jug
entries.description: Holds up to 1 gallon.

entries.name: Keelboat
entries.description: Speed 1 mph, crew 1, 6 passengers, cargo ½ ton, AC 15, 100 HP, damage threshold 10.

entries.name: Ladder
entries.description: 10 feet tall. You must climb to move up or down it.

entries.name: Lamp
entries.description: Burns oil to shed Bright Light in a 15-foot radius and Dim Light for 30 feet more.

entries.name: Bullseye Lantern
entries.description: Burns oil to cast Bright Light in a 60-foot Cone and Dim Light for an additional 60 feet.

entries.name: Hooded Lantern
entries.description: Burns oil to shed Bright Light in a 30-foot radius and Dim Light for 30 feet more; its hood can lower the light.

entries.name: Lock
entries.description: Comes with a key. Without it, picked with Thieves' Tools on a DC 15 Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check.

entries.name: Longship
entries.description: Speed 3 mph, crew 40, 150 passengers, cargo 10 tons, AC 15, 300 HP, damage threshold 15.

entries.name: Magnifying Glass
entries.description: Advantage on ability checks to appraise or inspect a highly detailed item. In sunlight, it can light a fire in about 5 minutes.

entries.name: Malice
entries.description: Inhaled. DC 15 Constitution saving throw or Poisoned and Blinded for 1 hour.

entries.name: Manacles
entries.description: As a Utilize action, bind a Grappled, Incapacitated or Restrained Small or Medium creature within 5 feet on a DC 13 Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check: Disadvantage on its attack rolls, Restrained if chained in place. Escaping takes DC 20 Dexterity (Sleight of Hand), bursting them DC 25 Strength (Athletics). With a key.

entries.name: Map
entries.description: Consulting an accurate map gives a +5 bonus to Wisdom (Survival) checks to find your way in the place it shows.

entries.name: Mastiff
entries.description: Carries up to 195 lb.

entries.name: Midnight Tears
entries.description: Ingested. No effect until midnight; anything that ends the Poisoned condition neutralizes it. At midnight, DC 17 Constitution saving throw: 31 (9d6) Poison damage, half on a success.

entries.name: Mirror
entries.description: A handheld steel mirror, for cosmetics, peeking around corners or signalling with light.

entries.name: Mule
entries.description: Carries up to 420 lb.

entries.name: Navigator's Tools
entries.description: Wisdom. Plot a course (DC 10), or find your position by the stars (DC 15).

entries.name: Net
entries.description: Thrown in place of an attack at a creature within 15 feet: it must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw (DC 8 + your Dexterity modifier and Proficiency Bonus) or be Restrained (Huge or larger: no effect). Escaping takes an action and a DC 10 Strength (Athletics) check; the net has AC 10 and 5 HP.

entries.name: Flask of Oil
entries.description: A flask of oil: fuel for a lamp or a lantern, or thrown to douse a creature or an object.

entries.name: Oil of Taggit
entries.description: Contact. DC 13 Constitution saving throw or Poisoned and Unconscious for 24 hours; it wakes up if it takes damage.

entries.name: Pale Tincture
entries.description: Ingested. DC 16 Constitution saving throw or 3 (1d6) Poison damage and Poisoned; the save again every 24 hours, 3 (1d6) Poison damage per failure, damage that can't be healed meanwhile. Ends after seven successes.

entries.name: Paper
entries.description: One sheet holds about 250 handwritten words.

entries.name: Parchment
entries.description: One sheet of parchment can hold about 250 handwritten words.

entries.name: Perfume
entries.description: For 1 hour after you apply it, Advantage on Charisma (Persuasion) checks to influence an Indifferent Humanoid within 5 feet.

entries.name: Basic Poison
entries.description: As a Bonus Action, coats a weapon or three pieces of ammunition: a creature taking Piercing or Slashing damage from it takes an extra 1d4 Poison damage. It lasts 1 minute or until its damage is dealt.

entries.name: Poisoner's Kit
entries.description: Intelligence. Detect a poisoned object (DC 10). Craft: Basic Poison.

entries.name: Pole
entries.description: 10 feet long: touches something up to 10 feet away, and gives Advantage to vault in a jump.

entries.name: Pony
entries.description: Carries up to 225 lb.

entries.name: Iron Pot
entries.description: Holds up to 1 gallon.

entries.name: Pouch
entries.description: A pouch holds up to 6 pounds within one-fifth of a cubic foot.

entries.name: Priest's Pack
entries.description: Contains a backpack, a blanket, holy water, a lamp, 7 days of rations, a robe and a tinderbox.

entries.name: Purple Worm Poison
entries.description: Injury. DC 21 Constitution saving throw: 35 (10d6) Poison damage, half on a success.

entries.name: Quiver
entries.description: A quiver holds up to 20 arrows.

entries.name: Portable Ram
entries.description: A +4 bonus to the Strength check to break down a door; a helper gives Advantage on it.

entries.name: Rations (1 day)
entries.description: Travel-ready food for one day: jerky, dried fruit, hardtack and nuts.

entries.name: Reliquary
entries.description: A holy symbol kept in a small reliquary.

entries.name: Robe
entries.description: A robe has vocational or ceremonial significance.

entries.name: Rod
entries.description: An arcane focus: a sorcerer, a warlock or a wizard can use it as a spellcasting focus.

entries.name: Rope
entries.description: 50 feet of rope. Tying a knot takes a DC 10 Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check; bursting it, a DC 20 Strength (Athletics) check.

entries.name: Rowboat
entries.description: Speed 1½ mph, crew 1, 3 passengers, AC 11, 50 HP.

entries.name: Sack
entries.description: Holds up to 30 pounds within 1 cubic foot.

entries.name: Exotic Saddle
entries.description: Comes with a bit, a bridle, reins and all the gear needed to use it. Needed to ride an aquatic or a flying mount.

entries.name: Military Saddle
entries.description: Comes with a bit, a bridle, reins and all the gear needed to use it. Advantage on ability checks to remain mounted.

entries.name: Riding Saddle
entries.description: Comes with a bit, a bridle, reins and all the gear needed to use it.

entries.name: Sailing Ship
entries.description: Speed 2 mph, crew 20, 20 passengers, cargo 100 tons, AC 15, 300 HP, damage threshold 15.

entries.name: Scholar's Pack
entries.description: Contains a backpack, a blanket, a book, ink, an ink pen, a lamp, 10 flasks of oil, 10 sheets of parchment and a tinderbox.

entries.name: Serpent Venom
entries.description: Injury. DC 11 Constitution saving throw: 10 (3d6) Poison damage, half on a success.

entries.name: Shovel
entries.description: In 1 hour, digs a hole 5 feet on each side in soil.

entries.name: Signal Whistle
entries.description: Blown as a Utilize action, it can be heard up to 600 feet away.

entries.name: Sled
entries.description: Pulled by animals, which move up to five times their carrying capacity, the vehicle included.

entries.name: Spellbook
entries.description: Essential for wizards, a spellbook is a leather-bound tome with 100 blank vellum pages suitable for recording spells.

entries.name: Spider's Sting
entries.description: Injury. DC 13 Constitution saving throw or Poisoned for 1 hour; failed by 5 or more, also Unconscious, waking up if it takes damage or is shaken awake.

entries.name: Iron Spikes
entries.description: A bundle of ten. Hammered as a Utilize action into wood or earth, to jam a door or tie a rope or chain to.

entries.name: Spyglass
entries.description: Objects seen through it are magnified to twice their size.

entries.name: Staff
entries.description: An arcane focus, also a Quarterstaff: a sorcerer, a warlock or a wizard can use it as a spellcasting focus.

entries.name: String
entries.description: 10 feet long. You can tie a knot in it as a Utilize action.

entries.name: Tent
entries.description: Sleeps up to two Small or Medium creatures.

entries.name: Tinderbox
entries.description: Flint, fire steel and tinder to kindle a fire: lighting a candle, a lamp, a lantern or a torch takes a Bonus Action.

entries.name: Torch
entries.description: Burns for 1 hour, shedding Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for 20 feet more. It can strike for 1 Fire damage.

entries.name: Torpor
entries.description: Ingested. DC 15 Constitution saving throw or Poisoned for 4d6 hours, its Speed halved meanwhile.

entries.name: Truth Serum
entries.description: Ingested. DC 11 Constitution saving throw or Poisoned for 1 hour, unable to knowingly tell a lie.

entries.name: Vial
entries.description: Holds up to 4 ounces.

entries.name: Wagon
entries.description: Pulled by animals, which move up to five times their carrying capacity, the vehicle included.

entries.name: Wand
entries.description: An arcane focus: a sorcerer, a warlock or a wizard can use it as a spellcasting focus.

entries.name: Warhorse
entries.description: Carries up to 540 lb.

entries.name: Warship
entries.description: Speed 2½ mph, crew 60, 60 passengers, cargo 200 tons, AC 15, 500 HP, damage threshold 20.

entries.name: Waterskin
entries.description: Holds up to 4 pints of water.

entries.name: Wooden Staff
entries.description: A druidic focus, also a Quarterstaff: a druid or a ranger can use it as a spellcasting focus.

entries.name: Wyvern Poison
entries.description: Injury. DC 14 Constitution saving throw: 24 (7d6) Poison damage, half on a success.

entries.name: Yew Wand
entries.description: A druidic focus: a druid or a ranger can use it as a spellcasting focus.
